plan.title: An exciting opportunity
plan.body: Following the success of the Grand Plan, {holder} is moving up to lead Special Projects, which has been created for the purpose. {holder} will be greatly missed from the end of month {month}. The seat is open until then, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

movedUp.title: An exciting opportunity
movedUp.body: {holder} has been seconded upstairs to Special Projects, which needed someone at short notice and has found them. {holder} will be greatly missed from the end of month {month}. The seat is open until then, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

left.title: An exciting opportunity
left.body: Following the departure of {holder}, the seat is open until the end of month {month}, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Until then, the team reports to whoever {holder} reported to, who has been asked to be available. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

fired.title: An exciting opportunity
fired.body: Following a review of conduct, {holder} is no longer with the company, effective immediately, and the badge has been collected. The seat is open until the end of month {month}, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. People and Culture would like to thank everyone who raised concerns, in confidence. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

created.title: An exciting opportunity
created.body: A new post of Team Leader (Delivery) has been created, to lead the team that {holder} leads, so that {holder} can focus on leading it. It will be filled at the end of month {month}, through a fair and transparent process. {holder} remains in post, with the same title and a new chart. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

won.title: Congratulations: Team lead
won.body: You have the seat. The decision was unanimous, in that one person made it. Your old colleagues now report to you, and have been asked to be pleased. Your new desk is on Floor 2, and the lift will take you there.

lost.title: Congratulations to {winner}
lost.body: After a fair and transparent process, the seat goes to {winner}, who is now your boss. Your application was strong, and has been kept on file, which is where strong applications go. You stay where you are, at the same desk, facing the other way.

blocked.title: Congratulations to {winner}
blocked.body: After a fair and transparent process, the seat goes to {winner}, who is now your boss. The incident during the process was taken into account, as the process requires. Your application has been kept on file, with the incident report stapled to the front. You stay where you are, at the same desk, facing the other way.

plan.title: An exciting opportunity
plan.body: Following the success of the Grand Plan, {holder} is moving up to be Director of Operations, a post that reports to Floor 3 and sits on it. {holder} will be greatly missed from the end of month {month}. The seat is open until then, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Expressions of interest from Team leads are welcome, and will be filed by grade.

movedUp.title: An exciting opportunity
movedUp.body: {holder} has been seconded to be Director of Operations, a post that reports to Floor 3 and sits on it, which had asked for someone senior and available, and found that these were the same person. {holder} will be greatly missed from the end of month {month}. The seat is open until then, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Expressions of interest from Team leads are welcome, and will be filed by grade.

left.title: An exciting opportunity
left.body: Following the departure of {holder}, the seat is open until the end of month {month}, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Until then, whoever {holder} reported to has been asked to be available, and has set an out-of-office. Expressions of interest from Team leads are welcome, and will be filed by grade.

fired.title: An exciting opportunity
fired.body: Following a review of conduct, {holder} is no longer with the company, effective immediately. The seat is open until the end of month {month}, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. People and Culture would like to thank everyone who raised concerns, in confidence. Expressions of interest from Team leads are welcome, and will be filed by grade.

created.title: An exciting opportunity
created.body: A new post of Deputy Head of Operations has been created, to lead what {holder} leads, so that {holder} can focus on leading it. It will be filled at the end of month {month}, through a fair and transparent process. {holder} remains in post, with the same title and a larger chart. Expressions of interest from Team leads are welcome, and will be filed by grade.

won.title: Congratulations: Middle manager
won.body: You have the seat. It was decided at a level you have not yet been told about, by a process you will now be asked to run. The other leads on the floor now report to you, and have accepted a calendar invitation to say so. Your new office is on Floor 3, and the lift will take you there.

lost.title: Congratulations to {winner}
lost.body: After a fair and transparent process, the seat goes to {winner}, who is now your boss. Your application showed real leadership potential, which is the phrase used for applications that did not get it. You stay where you are, on Floor 2, and are asked to support the transition.

blocked.title: Congratulations to {winner}
blocked.body: After a fair and transparent process, the seat goes to {winner}, who is now your boss. The incident during the process was taken into account, as the process requires, and was minuted, as the incident requires. You stay where you are, on Floor 2, and are asked to support the transition.

plan.title: An exciting opportunity
plan.body: Following the success of the Grand Plan, {holder} is moving up to be Head of Portfolio, a post with a view of Floor 4's scaffolding. {holder} will be greatly missed from the end of month {month}. The seat at the top of Floor 3 is open until then, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. It is the last seat on this floor. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed in the lift.

movedUp.title: An exciting opportunity
movedUp.body: {holder} has been seconded to be Head of Portfolio, a post with a view of Floor 4's scaffolding, which had asked for someone senior and available, and found that these were the same person. {holder} will be greatly missed from the end of month {month}. The seat at the top of Floor 3 is open until then, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. It is the last seat on this floor. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed in the lift.

left.title: An exciting opportunity
left.body: Following the departure of {holder}, the seat at the top of Floor 3 is open until the end of month {month}, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Until then, whoever {holder} reported to has been asked to be available, and has set an out-of-office. It is the last seat on this floor. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed in the lift.

fired.title: An exciting opportunity
fired.body: Following a review of conduct, {holder} is no longer with the company, effective immediately. The seat at the top of Floor 3 is open until the end of month {month}, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. People and Culture would like to thank everyone who raised concerns, in confidence. It is the last seat on this floor. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed in the lift.

created.title: An exciting opportunity
created.body: A new post of Programme Director has been created, to lead what {holder} leads, so that {holder} can focus on leading it. It will be filled at the end of month {month}, through a fair and transparent process. {holder} remains in post, with the same title and a larger chart. It is the last seat on this floor. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed in the lift.

won.title: Congratulations: the top of Floor 3
won.body: You have the seat. Nobody on Floor 3 is left above you, and upwards is closed. Your name has been sent to Facilities for a nameplate, and to the lift.

lost.title: Congratulations to {winner}
lost.body: After a fair and transparent process, the seat at the top of Floor 3 goes to {winner}, who is now your boss. You were a very strong candidate, and remain one, on Floor 3, in your current role. The lift has been told not to wait.

blocked.title: Congratulations to {winner}
blocked.body: After a fair and transparent process, the seat at the top of Floor 3 goes to {winner}, who is now your boss. The incident during the process was taken into account at the highest level available on Floor 3. You stay where you are, in your current role, and the lift has been told not to wait.

win.title: The top of Floor 3
lines: Your pass now opens the lift lobby at the top of Floor 3. In the lift there is a button for Floor 4, with a piece of tape over it. Someone has written Soon on the tape, and dated it.

Floors 4 to 10 are closed for refurbishment, as they have been since the last refurbishment. Your office up there will be ready when they are. Until then you keep the one you have, with a new nameplate that is slightly too long for the door.

Your payout has been processed. It is a voucher for the staff restaurant, a framed certificate that says Leadership, and the right to be copied in on everything. The real payout is in the penthouse, with the Chief Executive, behind the tape.
Somewhere below you, a Junior employee is filling in a Monthly Status Report. You will never read it, and that is the job.

results.title: You have reached the top of Floor 3
results.intro: The building does not currently go any higher. Here is how you got here, and what the citation leaves out.

win.ending: You reached the top of Floor 3 in month {month}, which is as high as the building goes for now.

lines: Your pass now opens the lift lobby at the top of Floor 3. In the lift there is a button for Floor 4, with a piece of tape over it. Someone has written Soon on the tape, and dated it.

Floors 4 to 10 are closed for refurbishment. Your office up there will be ready when they are, and so, you are told, will a number of people who would like a word with whoever got rid of their friends on the way up.

Your payout has been processed. It is a voucher for the staff restaurant, a framed certificate that says Integrity, and a seat on the Speak Up Steering Group. The real payout is in the penthouse, with the Chief Executive, behind the tape.
Nobody on Floor 3 will have a coffee with you, in case it is a meeting. It is lonely at the top of Floor 3, and it was quicker this way.
Your pass now opens the lift lobby at the top of Floor 3. In the lift there is a button for Floor 4, with a piece of tape over it. Someone has written Soon on the tape, and dated it.
The post was created for whoever got it, and that was you. Your predecessor still has the title, the view and the plant, and now reports to a box on a chart with your name in it.

Your payout has been processed. It is a voucher for the staff restaurant, a framed copy of the chart, and the right to be copied in on everything. The real payout is in the penthouse, with the Chief Executive, behind the tape.

Your pass now opens the lift lobby at the top of Floor 3. In the lift there is a button for Floor 4, with a piece of tape over it. Someone has written Soon on the tape, and dated it, which is more than your Plans had.

Floors 4 to 10 are closed for refurbishment. On the way up you left a sign on a door, a slide with no dates, and a tool with a lighthouse on it. None of them has been opened since, and all of them are on your CV.

Your payout has been processed. It is a voucher for the staff restaurant, a framed certificate that says Delivered, and the right to be copied in on everything. The real payout is in the penthouse, with the Chief Executive, behind the tape.
Somewhere below you, someone has just opened a door with Excellence on it, and found a chair. You will be at a conference when they ask.

forYou.text: Was passed over for the seat, which went to you.

forSomeoneElse.text: Was passed over for the seat, which went to {winner}.

self.why: {decider} considered every candidate carefully, and then {decider}, and was persuaded.
self.told: {decider} considered every candidate carefully, and then {decider}, and was persuaded.

owed.why: {decider} owed {who} a favour, and this was the favour.
owed.told: {decider} and {who} go back a long way.

protege.why: {decider} has looked after {who} for years, mostly from a distance.
protege.told: {who} has worked under {decider} for some time, in one sense or another.

circle.why: {who} is in {decider}'s circle, if not at its centre.
circle.told: {who} and {decider} are often at the same lunches.

credited.why: {who} had the credit for the Grand Plan, as far as {decider} could see.
credited.told: {decider} had read the launch e-mail, and remembered whose name was on it.

calledIn.why: You called in the favour {decider} owed you.
calledIn.told: {decider} had a debt to settle, and settled it.

delivered.why: You had really done the Grand Plan, and {decider} knew it.
delivered.told: {decider} had noticed who really did the work.

results.why: You did the actual work, month after month, and {decider} had seen it.
results.told: {decider} had noticed who did the actual work.

looks.why: You looked the part: decks, confidence and the right phrases.

warm.why: What had reached {decider} of you was good.

neutral.why: {decider} had heard of you, and nothing in particular.

cold.why: What had reached {decider} of you was not good.

mistake.why: There was an incident while the seat was open, and {decider} could not be seen to reward it.
mistake.told: The incident report was taken into account by {decider}, and so was its timing.

decider.text: You came to see them about the seat, before it was filled.

sway.text: Someone they listen to put in a word for you about the seat.
Someone who owed you a favour put in a word for you about the seat.

story.text: A story that you had had very little to do with the Grand Plan.

acts.diary: A long lunch about the seat, which somebody paid for.

close: It was close, and it went to {who} on grounds that were not minuted.
untold: It was {decider}'s decision, and {decider} made it.
inFact: The seat was in the gift of {decider}. {why}

results.plan: In month {month}, {holder} moved up, and the seat went to {winner}.
results.movedUp: In month {month}, {holder} was seconded upstairs, and the seat went to {winner}.
results.left: In month {month}, after {holder} had left, the seat went to {winner}.
results.fired: In month {month}, after {holder} had been fired, the seat went to {winner}.
results.created: In month {month}, a post was created out of {holder}'s team, and it went to {winner}.

plan.reality: Month {month}: {job}, when {holder}'s Grand Plan was really done, and {holder} moved up.
plan.appearance: Month {month}: {job}, when {holder}'s Grand Plan was done for show, and {holder} moved up anyway.

route.created: Month {month}: {job}, in a post created out of the team {holder} led.
route.demoted: Month {month}: back down to {job}, after an incident.

gone.title: A change of leadership
gone.body: Internal Audit has completed its review of Floor 2's leadership, and {holder} is no longer with the company. The expenses have been reclaimed, including a lunch that turned out to have been yours. Everyone on Floor 2 is very busy, all at once, in the other direction from you.

survived.title: Audit complete
survived.body: Internal Audit has completed its review of Floor 2's leadership, and found nothing that a policy did not already allow. {holder} has been told the review is closed, and roughly where it came from.

gone.title: A secondment to the refurbishment
gone.body: Your nomination has been successful. {holder} is seconded to lead the Floors 4 to 10 Refurbishment Programme, which has an office on a floor with no lights, and is thrilled. The nomination was confidential, and {holder} has written to thank whoever it was.

survived.title: Nominations closed
survived.body: The Board has thanked everyone for their nominations, and decided that {holder} is too valuable where they are. {holder} has been told about the nomination, by name.

gone.title: A change in the team
gone.body: An all-staff e-mail thanks {holder} for their contribution, and says nothing else, at length. The desk has been cleared by somebody from Security, who took the plant. Nobody has said why, and everybody on the floor is very careful not to look at you while not saying it.

survived.title: Business as usual
survived.body: The concerns raised about {holder} have been looked into, and were found to be concerns. {holder} is staying, and has been told, in confidence, where they came from. {holder} says good morning to you now, every morning, by name, and waits for you to say it back.

remembered.text: You tried to get them fired, and they know it.
